description: This PHP source file defines a controller class 'Zone' in the OpenCart Admin module, specifically within the 'Localisation' namespace. It manages CRUD operations (list, form, and index) for geographic zones, including filtering, sorting, pagination, and view rendering.

classes.name: Zone
classes.description: Controller class for managing localisation zones in the admin panel, providing listing, filtering, pagination, and form handling for zones.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for displaying the zones page, handling filters, sorting, pagination, and rendering the view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the request to get the list of zones and outputs it as a response.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated, sorted list of zones based on filters and returns the view rendering the zones list.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Prepares data for the zone form view (add/edit), sets up filters and form context.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving (adding/editing) zones via AJAX, with validation, permission checks, and JSON response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deleting selected zones via AJAX, with permission checks and JSON response.
